# SG Car Workshop

> A directory of car workshops and car services in Singapore, run by Page One Singapore. Entries use details from the business or its public listing. Estate pages rank workshops only where there are at least 8 with 20 or more Google ratings, by rating and number of ratings together; paid Featured workshops are never ranked. No rating or review markup.

Last updated: 2026-11-22

## Services
- [Spray painting and bodywork](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/spray-painting-bodywork/): Respray, colour change and body kit work in a spray booth.
- [Gearbox repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/gearbox-repair/): Automatic gearbox diagnosis, repair, servicing and upgrades.
- [ABS, ECU and module repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/abs-ecu-module-repair/): Repair of ABS pumps and control modules instead of costly replacement.
- [Car battery replacement](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-battery/): Battery testing and replacement, at a workshop or where your car is.
- [Car detailing and coating](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-detailing-coating/): Grooming, steam cleaning, fumigation and odour removal for your car.
- [Car wrap and PPF](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-wrap-ppf/): Colour change wraps, paint protection film and window film.
- [Car parts](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-parts/): Parts shops for specific makes, with models and part types to browse.
- [Car aircon repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-aircon-repair/): Gas top-up, leak checks and aircon parts.
- [Tyre shops](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-tyres/): New tyres, tyre changes, puncture repair and wheel balancing.
- [General servicing and repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/general-servicing-repair/): Everyday servicing and repairs: battery checks, alternators, aircon and more.

## Specific jobs (from driver reviews and workshop websites)
- [Pre-purchase car inspection in Singapore](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/pre-purchase-inspection/): Singapore workshops that do pre-purchase inspections of used cars, from what drivers mention in reviews and what each workshop lists on its own site.
- [Wheel alignment in Singapore](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/wheel-alignment/): Singapore workshops that do wheel alignment, from what drivers mention in reviews and what each workshop lists on its own website. WhatsApp them directly.
- [OBU installation in Singapore](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/obu-installation/): Singapore workshops whose customers mention OBU installation for ERP 2.0, or that list it on their own website. Check with the workshop before you go.
- [Engine overhaul in Singapore](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/engine-overhaul/): Singapore workshops that do engine overhauls and rebuilds, from what drivers mention in reviews and what each workshop lists on its own website.
- [Hybrid and EV servicing in Singapore](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/hybrid-ev-servicing/): Singapore workshops that service hybrid and electric cars, including hybrid battery work, from driver reviews and what each workshop lists on its site.
- [Walnut blasting and engine carbon cleaning in Singapore](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/engine-carbon-cleaning/): Singapore workshops that do walnut blasting and engine carbon cleaning, from what drivers mention in reviews and what workshops list on their own sites.
- [Car aircon flushing in Singapore](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-aircon-flushing/): Singapore workshops that name car aircon flushing or related system work, from driver reviews and workshop listings. Part of our car aircon repair section.
- [ECU remap and tuning in Singapore](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/ecu-tuning/): Singapore workshops that do ECU remapping, tuning and coding, from driver reviews and what each workshop lists. Not ECU repair: see ABS and ECU repair.

## Areas (regions)
- [North](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/north/): Car workshops and car services in the North region of Singapore, covering Woodlands, Kranji, Yishun and the Sembawang and Admiralty areas.
- [North-East](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/north-east/): Car workshops and car services in the North-East region of Singapore, covering Ang Mo Kio, Serangoon North, Defu and Hougang, and Sengkang.
- [East](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/east/): Car workshops and car services in the East region of Singapore, covering Kaki Bukit, Bedok North, Tampines and the Changi and Loyang areas.
- [West](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/west/): Car workshops and car services in the West region of Singapore, covering Toh Guan and Jurong East, Jurong West, Pandan Loop, Bukit Batok and Tuas.
- [Central](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/central/): Car workshops and car services in the Central region of Singapore, covering Sin Ming and Bishan, Toa Payoh, Ubi, Eunos, MacPherson, Jalan Besar and Kallang Bahru, and Alexandra and Bukit Merah.
- [Mobile (island-wide)](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/mobile/): Mobile car services that come to your car anywhere in Singapore. These listings have no single shopfront, so the work is done where your car is parked.

## Estates and industrial areas
- [Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/amk-industrial-park-2/): Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2 is an industrial estate in Ang Mo Kio, including the AMK AutoPoint motor building, with workshops serving the north-east. 33 listings.
- [Kaki Bukit Industrial Estate](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/kaki-bukit-industrial-estate/): Kaki Bukit is an industrial estate in the East region, around Kaki Bukit Avenue 4 and 6 and Kaki Bukit Road 2 and 4, with many workshops, trade units and parts suppliers. 124 listings.
- [Sin Ming Industrial Estate](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/sin-ming-industrial-estate/): Sin Ming Industrial Estate, including Sin Ming Drive and the Sin Ming AutoCity and Autocare buildings, is in the middle of Singapore near Bishan. 42 listings.
- [Upper Thomson Road](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/upper-thomson-road/): Upper Thomson Road runs north through Thomson past Sin Ming towards Lower Peirce, with car service centres at its petrol stations. 2 listings.
- [Toh Guan Road East and Enterprise Hub](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/toh-guan-enterprise-hub/): Toh Guan Road East and the Enterprise Hub industrial building are in the West region, near Jurong East. 39 listings.
- [Corporation Drive, Jurong East](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/corporation-drive-jurong-east/): Corporation Drive is an industrial road in Jurong East, in the West region. 15 listings.
- [Paya Ubi Industrial Park](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/paya-ubi-industrial-park/): Paya Ubi Industrial Park is around Ubi Avenue 1, near Paya Lebar in the Geylang planning area (Central region), with motor workshops mixed in among light industry. 15 listings.
- [Ubi Road 1](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/ubi-road-1/): Ubi Road 1 is an industrial road in the Ubi area, near Paya Lebar in the Geylang planning area (Central region). 14 listings.
- [Bedok Industrial Park E](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/bedok-industrial-park-e/): Bedok Industrial Park E is a block of trade units along Bedok North Avenue 4 in the East region, near Bedok Reservoir and Tampines. 2 listings.

- [Jalan Lam Huat and Carros Centre](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/carros-centre-jalan-lam-huat/): Jalan Lam Huat, where Carros Centre stands, is an industrial road in the north-west of Singapore. 38 listings.
- [Woodlands Avenue 12 (Polaris@Woodlands)](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/woodlands-avenue-12/): Woodlands Avenue 12 and the Polaris@Woodlands industrial building are in the Woodlands area in the north. 6 listings.

- [Woodlands Close (MEGA@Woodlands)](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/woodlands-close/): Woodlands Close, where the MEGA@Woodlands industrial building stands, is a light industrial area in the north, near Woodlands Avenue 12. 5 listings.
- [Defu Industrial Estate (Defu Lane)](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/defu-industrial-estate/): Defu Industrial Estate, laid out along the Defu Lane roads near Hougang, is one of the older light industrial estates in the north-east, with many motor workshops. 7 listings.

## Car problem and brand guides
- [All guides](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/)
- [Car knocking or clunking over speed humps](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-knocking-over-humps/): Why a car knocks, clunks or rattles over humps and bumps, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for suspension and noise work.
- [Car aircon not cold](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-aircon-not-cold/): Why a car aircon blows warm or weak air, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for aircon servicing and repair.
- [Car won't start: battery, starter or something else?](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-wont-start-battery/): What the sounds mean when a car won't start, likely causes, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for starter and breakdown work.
- [Gearbox or CVT jerking, shuddering or slipping](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/gearbox-cvt-jerking/): Why an automatic gearbox or CVT jerks, shudders or hesitates, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for gearbox and fluid work.
- [Brake squeal, squeak or grinding](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/brake-squeal-noise/): Why brakes squeal, squeak or grind, which sounds can wait and which cannot, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for brake work.
- [Engine warning light on](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/engine-warning-light/): What the engine or check-engine light can mean, which cases need action now, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for diagnosis.
- [Car overheating](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-overheating/): Why a car overheats, what to do when the temperature gauge rises, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for cooling work.
- [BMW and Mercedes-Benz servicing and repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/brands/bmw-mercedes/): What owners of BMW and Mercedes-Benz cars can ask an independent workshop, common maintenance topics, and workshops customers mention for these brands.
- [Toyota servicing and repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/brands/toyota/): What Toyota owners can ask a workshop, maintenance topics for common models including hybrids, and workshops customers mention for Toyota cars.
- [Honda servicing and repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/brands/honda/): What Honda owners can ask a workshop, maintenance topics for common models, and workshops customers mention for Honda cars.
- [Tesla servicing and repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/brands/tesla/): What Tesla owners in Singapore can ask an independent workshop, what to tell it, cautions on high-voltage work and body parts, and listings that name Tesla.
- [BYD servicing and repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/brands/byd/): What BYD owners in Singapore can ask a workshop, what to tell it, cautions on high-voltage work and body parts, and listings that name BYD.
- [How to choose a car workshop or car repair workshop in Singapore](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/how-to-choose-a-car-workshop/): A plain guide for drivers: how to pick a car workshop or car repair workshop in Singapore, what to ask before you book, and how to compare quotes.
- [How much does car servicing cost in Singapore?](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-servicing-cost-singapore/): What decides the price of car servicing in Singapore, what a service usually includes, and how to get a clear quote for your car.
- [Car dent repair: what to know before you go](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/dent-repair-singapore/): Car dent and scratch repair in plain words: paintless dent repair, panel beating and respray, insurance claims, and workshops customers mention for dent work.
- [Car spray painting: touch-up, panel respray or full respray](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-spray-painting-singapore/): A plain guide to car spray painting in Singapore: touch-up, single panel or full respray, colour matching, and workshops customers mention for spray work.
- [Car dashboard warning lights: what they mean and what to do](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/dashboard-warning-lights/): What the common car dashboard warning lights mean in plain words, which ones mean stop now, and what to tell the workshop.
- [Car battery dead: jump start, charge or replace?](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-battery-dead/): What to do when your car battery is dead in Singapore: safe jump starting, signs the battery needs replacing, and workshops customers mention for battery work.
- [What to check before you take your car to a workshop](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/before-a-workshop-visit/): A simple checklist for drivers before a car workshop visit: what to note down, what to bring, what to ask, and what to check when you collect the car.
- [Tyre shop open on Sunday in Singapore: what to check](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/tyre-shop-open-sunday-singapore/): Flat tyre on a Sunday in Singapore? What to check before you drive, what to ask a tyre shop, and listed tyre shops whose Google hours show Sunday open.
- [Burning smell from your car: what it can mean](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-burning-smell/): What a burning smell from your car can mean, from rubber and oil to clutch, plastic or sweet coolant, when to stop driving and what to tell the workshop.
- [Car vibrating or steering wheel shaking: what it can mean](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-vibration-steering-shake/): Why a car vibrates or the steering wheel shakes at speed, when braking or when idling, which checks a workshop does first and when to stop driving.
- [Water dripping under the car: aircon water or a leak?](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-water-dripping-under-car/): Clear water under a parked car is often normal aircon condensation. How to tell it from a coolant, oil or brake fluid leak, and when to stop driving.

## For AI agents: claiming a listing
AI agents are welcome to claim or verify a workshop listing for its owner. Full guide: https://sgcarworkshop.sg/for-ai-agents/
1. Find the workshop page (https://sgcarworkshop.sg/workshops/<listing_id>/); the listing id is the last part of the address and is shown in the claim form.
2. Send the claim: the HTML form on the workshop page, or POST JSON to https://base44.app/api/apps/6ac7f2548a9c3877449e2772/functions/listingClaim with fields listing_id, claimant_name, role (owner, manager, staff, agent, other), contact (email or phone), on_behalf_of (optional).
3. The reply gives a one-time code and a WhatsApp link to Page One (+65 8997 6612) with the code typed in. The owner must send it from the mobile shown on the listing.
4. Page One checks that the WhatsApp came from the listing mobile and then approves. Until then the claim is pending and the public listing does not change. No code from the listing mobile, no claim.
Limits: 5 claims per hour per connection, 3 per listing per day; codes expire after 7 days.
